apps.subtitle: Gecko-based browser, a real WebKit alternative
apps.localizedDescription: Reynard is an experimental Gecko-based web browser for iOS 13 and up, rendering pages with the same engine Firefox uses instead of Safari's WebKit. It is actively developed and published from the project's own GitHub releases.
apps.versionDescription:
Reynard 0.14.1 | Reynard

## Changes

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/compare/0.14.0...0.14.1

This is a minor release that fixes issues found in 0.14.0. For the complete list of changes, see the [0.14.0 release notes](https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/releases/tag/0.14.0).

### Bug Fixes & Improvements
- Fixed a crash when opening Reader Mode settings on some older iOS versions.
- Fixed the system serif font not being looked up correctly on webpages and in Reader Mode.
- Fixed a misleading JIT enablement banner appearing on jailbroken iOS 17.4 and later.
- Fixed media playback not resuming automatically after interruptions such as dictation.
